parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban or police targeting is documented, and national anti-discrimination/hate-crime provisions are a climate/recourse signal, though island enforcement is undocumented. The decisive traveler-facing exposure is state custody: placement follows the identity-document marker and in practice puts trans women in all-male facilities where they are threatened, with the detention watchdog in 2021 finding persistent serious violations across the parent state's facilities, extended to this island. Under the rubric, repeated oversight findings without documented remedy corroborate an unremedied Tier-1 institutional exposure rather than mitigating it. Resident gender-recognition, labour and healthcare provisions do not offset this. Social friction on a predominantly Muslim island and thin local legal help add risk, while the national combined homophobic/transphobic attack figure is not an island prevalence measure.
